title: Be an authorised booking entity
what: Be an authorised booking entity before providing a booking service for booked hire (taxi or rideshare) services.

sources.title: Transport Operations (Passenger Transport) Act 1994 (Qld)
sources.quote: A person must not provide a booking service for another person to drive a motor vehicle to provide a booked hire service unless the person is an authorised booking entity for the booked hire service.
